review: Good jeans but expensive compared with other brands.
Classic Levi's look, the dark indigo wash goes with everything.
Perfect slim fit, not too tight at the thighs and looks sharp with sneakers.
My third pair of 511s, the fit is consistent every time.
The denim is thick and good quality, feels like it will last for years.
The stretch makes them comfortable enough to wear all day.
Size runs small at the waist, I had to exchange for one size up.
The colour faded a lot after just a few washes.
The stitching on the back pocket came loose within a month.
Comfortable, stylish and durable. Best jeans I own.
The zip broke after two weeks, very disappointing for the price.
They stretch out and get loose after a full day of wear.
Length was perfect for me, no alteration needed.
Bit stiff at first but softened after a couple of washes.
Delivery was quick and the packaging was neat.
Bought them on sale and they were great value.
